name: rtl-diagram
description: Block diagrams of SystemVerilog RTL with verification findings and team notes on the ports they name.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Verible was not found. RTL Diagram uses its verible-verilog-syntax tool to read SystemVerilog.
Install it (macOS: brew install verible; Linux and Windows: a release from github.com/chipsalliance/verible), or point the extension to it:
[Set Verible path](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22rtlDiagram.veriblePath%22%5D)
[Rescan](command:rtlDiagram.refresh)

This folder holds several RTL projects. Choose the one to open; its RTL, verification runs and notes are shown on their own.
[Open a project](command:rtlDiagram.chooseProject)

No SystemVerilog modules found in this project.
[Configure sources](command:rtlDiagram.configureSources)
[Open another project](command:rtlDiagram.chooseProject)
Sources come from Bender.yml, a .f filelist, or all .sv/.v files.

No verification runs found in this project. Runs are read from reports/<run_id>/run.json.
[Open a run folder](command:rtlDiagram.openRun)

rtlDiagram.projectFolder.markdownDescription: Folder to read RTL, verification runs and notes from (absolute, or relative to the first workspace folder). Empty: the project chosen in the diagram's project menu (or with **RTL Diagram: Open Project…**), or the only project found.

rtlDiagram.liveUpdate.markdownDescription: Redraw the diagram whenever an RTL file is saved. When off, the diagram stays as drawn and a banner lists the changed files with a Refresh button. The toolbar's Live button toggles this per workspace.

rtlDiagram.veriblePath.markdownDescription: Path to `verible-verilog-syntax`. Used to parse SystemVerilog.

rtlDiagram.sourceMode.markdownDescription: Where RTL files come from. `auto` uses Bender.yml if present, then a filelist, then the include glob.

rtlDiagram.benderRoots.markdownDescription: Folders (workspace-relative) whose `Bender.yml` are roots. Empty: every Bender.yml in the workspace.

rtlDiagram.benderTargets.markdownDescription: Active Bender targets for source groups with a `target:` expression (e.g. `["synthesis", "xilinx"]`). Empty: plain RTL, where `test`, `simulation` and technology-specific groups are left out.

rtlDiagram.filelists.markdownDescription: Filelists (`.f`) to read. Supports plain paths, `-f`, `+incdir+`, `-v` and `-y`.

rtlDiagram.include.markdownDescription: Glob of RTL files used when there is no Bender.yml or filelist.

rtlDiagram.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs excluded from RTL discovery (testbenches by default).

rtlDiagram.netLabels.pattern.markdownDescription: Nets whose name matches this regular expression (case-insensitive) are drawn as named labels at each pin instead of wires. Clocks and resets by default. Empty to disable.

rtlDiagram.netLabels.minLoads.markdownDescription: Nets with at least this many loads in a view are drawn as named labels instead of wires. `0` disables.

rtlDiagram.layout.spacing.markdownDescription: How much room the layout leaves between blocks and between parallel wires. `roomy` separates wires best but fits less on screen. The toolbar's spacing button changes it per workspace.

rtlDiagram.notesFolder.markdownDescription: Folder (in each workspace folder) where diagram notes are stored, one JSON file per note. Commit it to share notes through git.

rtlDiagram.theme.markdownDescription: Diagram theme. `auto` follows the VS Code colour theme.

rtlDiagram.colors.block.markdownDescription: Block fill colour (CSS). Empty: theme default.

rtlDiagram.colors.error.markdownDescription: Colour for `error` findings. Empty: theme default.

rtlDiagram.colors.warning.markdownDescription: Colour for `warning` findings. Empty: theme default.

rtlDiagram.colors.note.markdownDescription: Colour for `note` findings. Empty: theme default.

rtlDiagram.colors.issue.markdownDescription: Colour of source-issue marks (syntax errors and the like) on the diagram. Empty: theme default (magenta).

rtlDiagram.colors.portGroups.markdownDescription: Colour per port-name prefix, e.g. `{ "s_axi_aw": "#1565C0" }`. Longest prefix wins.
